points.text: Un **TAD** es un conjunto de valores y operaciones definidos **con independencia de la implementación**. En Java, la **interfaz** declara las operaciones y la **clase** que la implementa da el código de cada una (no al revés).

refs.title: NIST DADS · abstract data type
refs.quote: A set of data values and associated operations that are precisely specified independent of any particular implementation.

refs.title: Oracle · Java Tutorials: Defining an Interface
refs.quote: When an instantiable class implements an interface, it provides a method body for each of the methods declared in the interface.

points.text: **Cola** (FIFO): solo se accede al elemento más antiguo; se inserta por el **final (cola)** y se saca por la **cabecera**. Se puede implementar con estructuras dinámicas (listas enlazadas) o con arrays.

refs.title: NIST DADS · queue
refs.quote: A collection of items in which only the earliest added item may be accessed. Basic operations are add (to the tail ) or enqueue and delete (from the head ) or dequeue.

refs.title: NIST DADS · queue
refs.quote: Also known as "first-in, first-out" or FIFO.

refs.title: Oracle Java SE 21 · Queue
refs.quote: In a FIFO queue, all new elements are inserted at the tail of the queue.

refs.title: Oracle Java SE 21 · LinkedList
refs.quote: Doubly-linked list implementation of the List and Deque interfaces.

refs.title: Oracle Java SE 21 · Queue
refs.quote: All Known Implementing Classes: AbstractQueue , ArrayBlockingQueue , ArrayDeque

points.text: **Pila** (LIFO): se puede implementar sobre un **array** (en Java, `ArrayDeque`, más rápida que `Stack`).

refs.title: Oracle Java SE 21 · ArrayDeque
refs.quote: Resizable-array implementation of the Deque interface.

refs.title: Oracle Java SE 21 · ArrayDeque
refs.quote: This class is likely to be faster than Stack when used as a stack

points.text: **Lista enlazada simple**: cada elemento apunta al siguiente. En la **circular**, el último está enlazado con el primero.

refs.title: NIST DADS · linked list
refs.quote: A list implemented by each item having a link to the next item.

refs.title: NIST DADS · circular list
refs.quote: A variant of a linked list in which the nominal tail is linked to the head .

points.text: **Árbol 2-3-4**: árbol B de orden 4; sus nodos internos tienen **2, 3 o 4 hijos**.

refs.title: NIST DADS · 2-3-4 tree
refs.quote: A B-tree of order 4, that is, internal nodes have two, three, or four children

points.text: Recorrido en **preorden**: raíz, subárbol izquierdo, subárbol derecho.

refs.title: NIST DADS · preorder traversal
refs.quote: print(tree.root); preorder(tree.left_subtree); preorder(tree.right_subtree);

points.text: **Dijkstra**: caminos más cortos desde un vértice origen a todos los demás en un grafo dirigido **ponderado** (pesos no negativos).

refs.title: NIST DADS · Dijkstra's algorithm
refs.quote: An algorithm to find the shortest paths from a single source vertex to all other vertices in a weighted, directed graph . All weights must be nonnegative.

points.text: **Burbuja**: compara pares **adyacentes** y los intercambia si están desordenados, repitiendo hasta que no haya intercambios; O(n²) en general.

refs.title: NIST DADS · bubble sort
refs.quote: Sort by comparing each adjacent pair of items in a list in turn, swapping the items if necessary, and repeating the pass through the list until no swaps are done.

refs.title: NIST DADS · bubble sort
refs.quote: Complexity is O(n 2 ) for arbitrary data

points.text: **Radix**: ordenación por distribución que reparte los elementos en cubetas según **cada parte de la clave**, una pasada por dígito. Razonamiento: con d pasadas sobre n elementos y k cubetas, el coste es del orden de d·(n+k); con d y k fijos, **lineal** en n. **Heapsort**, en cambio, es O(n log n).

refs.title: NIST DADS · radix sort
refs.quote: A multiple pass distribution sort algorithm that distributes each item to a bucket according to part of the item's key beginning with the least significant part of the key.

refs.title: NIST DADS · heapsort
refs.quote: A sort algorithm that builds a heap , then repeatedly extracts the maximum item. Run time is O(n log n) .

points.text: **Algoritmo voraz**: toma siempre la **mejor solución inmediata (local)**.

refs.title: NIST DADS · greedy algorithm
refs.quote: An algorithm that always takes the best immediate, or local, solution while finding an answer.

points.text: **JSON** (RFC 8259): un valor es objeto, array, número o cadena, o uno de los literales **false, null y true** (en minúsculas). En los objetos, cada miembro es **nombre (cadena entre comillas dobles)** `:` valor.

refs.title: RFC 8259 · JSON
refs.quote: A JSON value MUST be an object, array, number, or string, or one of the following three literal names: false null true The literal names MUST be lowercase.

refs.title: RFC 8259 · JSON
refs.quote: member = string name-separator value

points.text: **CSV** (RFC 4180): un registro por línea, separadas por **CRLF**; los campos con saltos de línea, comillas o comas deberían ir **entre comillas dobles**.

refs.title: RFC 4180 · CSV
refs.quote: Each record is located on a separate line, delimited by a line break (CRLF).

refs.title: RFC 4180 · CSV
refs.quote: Fields containing line breaks (CRLF), double quotes, and commas should be enclosed in double-quotes.

points.text: **JPEG** es un estándar internacional (ISO/IEC 10918, 1992-1994). **ODF** 1.0 es la norma **ISO/IEC 26300:2006**.

refs.title: JPEG (ISO/IEC JTC 1/SC 29/WG 1) · JPEG 1
refs.quote: The JPEG 1 standard (ISO/IEC 10918) was created in 1992 (latest version, 1994)

refs.title: OASIS · Comité técnico OpenDocument
refs.quote: Open Document Format v1.0 has been approved by ISO/IEC JTC1 as an International Standard ISO/IEC 26300:2006

points.text: Normas PDF: **PDF/A** (archivo, ISO 19005), **PDF/E** (ISO 24517), **PDF/UA** (accesibilidad, ISO 14289) y **PDF/X** (preimpresión, ISO 15930). «PDF/I» no figura entre ellas.

refs.title: Library of Congress · PDF family
refs.quote: PDF/A standards (ISO 19005), PDF/R (ISO 23504), PDF/E (ISO 24517), PDF/UA (ISO 14289).

refs.title: Library of Congress · PDF family
refs.quote: PDF/A_family , PDF for Long-term Preservation

refs.title: Library of Congress · PDF family
refs.quote: PDF/UA-1, PDF Enhancement for Accessibility

refs.title: Library of Congress · PDF/X family
refs.quote: PDF/X is a family of ISO standards for constrained forms of the PDF_family of format specifications, designed for prepress digital data exchange.

points.text: **AV1** es un **códec de vídeo** abierto de la Alliance for Open Media.

refs.title: Alliance for Open Media · AV1
refs.quote: AV1 (AOMedia Video 1) is an open video codec designed to provide high-quality video compression with greater efficiency than previous codecs.
